talents.name: Crowd surge
talents.description: After his team scores, the whole team skates faster for 10 seconds.

talents.name: Spin move
talents.description: The first check that would strip him of the puck fails. Recharges in 12 seconds.

talents.name: Distraction
talents.description: When he carries the puck into the attacking zone, the opposing goalie reacts slower for 10 seconds. Recharges in 40 seconds.

talents.name: Cannon shot
talents.description: His fully charged shot is 30% harder.

talents.name: Rally cry
talents.description: Once a period, when his linemates are tired, their energy is refilled.

talents.name: Threader
talents.description: His flat passes cannot be picked off in the lane.

talents.name: Jets
talents.description: 10% faster with the puck when nobody is between him and the net.

talents.name: Crusher
talents.description: His body checks at speed always knock the puck loose.
